create_SuperPoint_model: create a SuperPoint model instance for keypoint detection and descriptor extraction from images
build_DescriptorHead: build a descriptor head module that transforms feature maps into 256-channel descriptors
run_sparsify_descriptors: run sparse descriptor extraction by interpolating dense descriptors at detected keypoint positions
run_upsample_descriptors: run bilinear upsampling of coarse descriptors to full image resolution
run_normalize_descriptors: run L2 normalization of descriptors with an optional scale factor
